supporting_evidence: The failed Linux report snapshot has monotonic_ms=66657, consistent with a 60-second rescan deadline after vault open.

poll_vault_change_hints checks filesystem watcher hints at crates/ui-egui/src/lib.rs:4232-4242; periodic reconciliation is scheduled at lib.rs:46 and 591-599, requested at 4253-4259, and started when operations are not busy at 4264-4282.

Canvas path/ID setup is not represented by canvas_text_editing() at lib.rs:881-883, so the refresh busy guard can permit a refresh during focused form entry. Refresh disables the fields and inserts status UI that changes their geometry, matching the report frames.

source_trace_followup.remaining_uncertainty: The report does not establish whether the timer or a filesystem event triggered this refresh, and does not prove the refresh timing relative to pixel capture.
candidate_repair_directions: Treat active Canvas path/ID form interaction as busy for reconciliation; preserve the pending rescan until Load or another stable handoff.

If the capture harness observes a refresh during screenshot correlation, wait for stable idle geometry, re-establish target focus with sibling/value guards, then recapture while keeping strict correlation checks.
Log periodic requests and filesystem watcher hints with distinct source labels.
